Nina (CS): Quick heads-up — Pinebrook onboarding: baseline p50 120ms, p95 220ms but during peak bursts hitting 650ms. CSM says renewal conversation next month; they flagged latency regressions as a risk.
Rahul (Solutions): Thanks. Do we have a first-pass mitigation? compact quant + model fallback seemed promising in bench runs.
Ben (Runtime): We can canary an int8 quant profile and a lightweight model for chat route. Proposed steps: 1) int8 canary on 5% of traffic, 2) routing rule p95>300ms -> fallback model rw-small-v2, 3) prefix caching for repeated prompts.
Nina (CS): Customer is open to a short canary as long as we capture quality metrics and cost delta. Please surface expected token-cost savings so I can include in renewal notes.
Ben (Runtime): Rough estimate from bench: int8 reduces tokens/second cost ~45%, throughput ~3x for same GPU. Quality regression on our eval set: BLEU/ROUGE shifts negligible; hallucination change ~0.6% (estimated). I'll run a prompt-set eval with Pinebrook's top 50 prompts.
Rahul (Solutions): I'll draft an enablement runbook with rollback steps and a quick checklist for their team (test env, seed prompts, smoke tests). Also add a note to capture qualitative feedback from product managers after 24h.
Nina (CS): Can we include a smooth routing policy so user-facing sessions don't oscillate? Suggest: short cooldown 5m, max 10% autoswitch per minute.
Ben (Runtime): Agreed. Sample routing config we can push for the canary:
```
routing:
  - condition: p95 > 300ms
    action: reroute
    target: rw-small-v2
quantization:
  profile: int8_preferred
  fallback: fp16
continuous_batch_ms: 20
```
Rahul (Solutions): I'll add that to the canary PR and link the docs. @deploy-bot can you schedule a 5% canary window for Pinebrook on Tue 2024-06-11 02:00 UTC?
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for pinebrook on 2024-06-11T02:00:00Z — 5% traffic, monitoring hooks enabled :robot_face:
Nina (CS): Thanks — please post results to #customer-success once we have 12h metrics. I'll prep the renewal talking points: cost delta, latency p95 improvements, and QA summary.
Ben (Runtime): Will run evals + perf plots, posting a short artifacts bundle (metrics + sample outputs) within 24h of canary start.
Rahul (Solutions): I'll own the enablement touchpoint — 1-hr sync w/ Pinebrook AMs after first 6h. Adding to calendar.
Nina (CS): Awesome. :thumbsup: Let's capture any customer feedback in the ticket we created (CS-4721) so renewals team has a single source of truth.
Ben (Runtime): Noted. I'll attach the eval scripts and seed prompt set there.
Nina (CS): If anyone sees a quality delta >1% on hallucination or unexplained diffs, rollback immediately and notify renewals.
Ben (Runtime): Yep — rollback plan in the PR. Will also enable prefix cache toggles behind a feature flag.
Rahul (Solutions): Thanks team — moving to action items.
